project.cli.built_for_phone: built {out_dir} for {target}: install it with adb install {executable}
project.cli.record_fps_needs_number: --record-fps needs a whole number of frames a second, 1 to {most}
project.cli.record_seconds_needs_number: --record-seconds needs a number of seconds above 0
project.cli.target_needs_system: --target needs linux, windows, macos or android
project.cli.usage: redgem                            open the project hub (new / recent games)
redgem build <game_dir> <out_dir> [--target linux|windows|macos|android]   make a standalone game (an executable, or an .apk)
redgem --version                  say which version of RedGem this is
--gpu auto|dedicated|integrated      graphics card for this run (default: the saved setting,
else the dedicated card when there is one)
play the game into a video (needs ffmpeg): each frame
advances the game by exactly 1/fps, drawn at the size
asked for and scaled to --record-scale; it ends after
N seconds, at Game.stop_recording or when the game quits
Where multiplayer games meet over the internet is a program of its own: redgem-relay;
a game run on a server for players to join is another: redgem-server.
<game_dir> holds {scene_file} (exported from Blender) and a {scripts_dir}/ folder.
project.hub.bad_name: Use letters, digits, spaces, - and _ for the name.
project.hub.name: Name
project.hub.no_games: No games yet. Create one on the left.
project.hub.not_a_game: {folder} is not a game (it has no {scene_file})
